title:
It’s Christmas Eve, Eve 🤶 🎄 

Our little elf’s (staff ) have been out delivering Christmas gift bags for each of our tenants! 

Giving Christmas gifts to our tenants is another tradition because it’s a way to show appreciation,and thoughtfulness.  It’s not just about the material item; it’s more about the effort, time, and care you put into picking something special for someone. 

#bluepitshousingaction #christmas2025
